name: Ling He Zhi Xin
source:
Enter a magical boarding school on our protagonist's eighteenth birthday as she makes a monumental decision and derails her life.

A ritual sacrifice got her everything she ever wanted: an adoring crowd (faceless), a newfound power (dangerous), and a whirlwind romance (one-sided). But without a heart in her chest, how could she love anyone back? Does she even need to?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954920/ZeroSum_Heart/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在我们的主角十八岁生日那天，她进入了一所神奇的寄宿学校，她做出了一个重大决定，并破坏了她的生活。

一场祭祀仪式为她带来了她想要的一切：崇拜的人群（不露面）、新发现的力量（危险）和旋风般的浪漫（单方面）。但胸中没有一颗心，她怎么能去爱任何人呢？她还需要这样做吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954920/ZeroSum_Heart/]Steam[/url]]
